preconditions.description: The number of testcases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each testcase, n must be between 1 and 50,000, and m must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a_i) == m for a_i in permutations)
preconditions.description: Each permutation a_i must have exactly m distinct integers from 1 to m.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers for each testcase.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= m for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be between 0 and m, representing the beauty of the permutations.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) == max_beauty[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The i-th output integer must equal the largest beauty of the permutation a_i * a_j for all j.
